briefdescription.para: PolyRing subclass for Weyl algebras: polynomial rings with the [d_i, x_i] = 1 derivative-variable commutation relations.

detaileddescription.para: Tracks a _derivative[i] / _commutative[i] index pair so the ring knows which variables are partial derivatives and which are the variables they differentiate. Optional homogeneous mode (_homogeneous_weyl_algebra) adds an extra homogenising variable _homog_var used to keep degrees compatible across commutator expansions. The static binomtable / diffcoeffstable cache binomial coefficients and derivative-coefficient products used by term-by-term multiplication.
